currency.basis: Historical record: license revoked 2022-04-30 (CNB); the archived official asset from 2021-12 documents the mark for the last independent brand period, which is the required evidence for this record.

identity.basis: The archived asset comes from the official sberbank.cz site of Sberbank CZ a.s. and shows the bank's own Sberbank emblem; record 15821 'Sberbank CZ' (CZ, sberbank.cz) is exactly this entity.

assessment.independenceRationale: The period mark is documented by the bank's own archived site (primary) and the lifecycle by the Czech National Bank (independent regulator); the live liquidation site is a distinct later source.

variant.basis: Standalone emblem without wordmark, square 283.46 canvas, green circle with striped checkmark; suitable for the square catalog cell.

candidate.detailsJudgement: All four striped check bands, their angles and the circle contour are preserved in the final render on both themes; internal transparency of the band gaps retained; no detail lost by optimization.
candidate.proportionsJudgement: Emblem fills the square canvas as in the source; circle and check proportions match the source raster reference at identical viewport; no stretching or cropping.
candidate.rationale: Replaces the accepted generic check-in-circle icon with the official Sberbank emblem (green circle with striped checkmark) used by Sberbank CZ during its operating period; the bank is a historical record (licence revoked 2022-04-30) and the archived official site asset documents the mark for the relevant period.
candidate.role: Standalone circular bank emblem without accompanying wordmark or text; suitable as the single icon of the square catalog cell.
transforms: Lossless copy of the downloaded original SVG as working.svg (no geometry change; source already fills its square 283.46x283.46 viewBox with transparent backing)

candidate.variant: Official Sberbank emblem variant served by sberbank.cz in December 2021: green (#279d38) circle with four white striped check bands; transparent square canvas.
candidate.visibleDiffExplanation: Before/after renders show a real design difference: the accepted icon is an outline circle with a plain checkmark in a different green, while the candidate is the official solid green circle with the striped Sberbank check used by the bank in its operating period; this is an evidenced correction to the actual historical mark, not a serialization change.

proposals.reason: The accepted SVG is a generic check-in-circle design in amber/green tones that does not match the official Sberbank mark used by Sberbank CZ during its operating period; the archived official sberbank.cz logo asset provides the correct standalone emblem as an original vector, so a replacement candidate is proposed.

sourceCandidate.rationale: Original vector emblem downloaded losslessly from the archived official Sberbank CZ site; replaces the accepted icon whose design (outline circle with plain check, non-official color) does not match the bank's actual operating-period mark (green #279d38 circle with striped Sberbank check). Saved asset: evidence/15821/logo-switcher-source.svg (sha256 9e29b920a762f490f8326d88f7ad9cffb6b83f3f915648b11c9e4c1a1eff8681).

sources.independenceGroup: web.archive.org capture of sberbank.cz primary site
sources.observation: Archived official Sberbank CZ website (capture 2021-12) serves logo-switcher.svg: the standalone Sberbank emblem, a green (#279d38) circle with the striped checkmark, viewBox 0 0 283.46 283.46, no accompanying wordmark.

CNB press release: Sberbank CZ banking license revoked with legal force on 2022-04-30 (bank unable to meet obligations since 2022-02-25); establishes the bank as a historical record whose relevant period is its operation under the Sberbank brand until 2022.

sources.independenceGroup: sberbank.cz liquidation site, separate from the archived operating-period site
sources.observation: Live sberbank.cz is now a liquidation/information site ('Sberbank CZ, a.s. v likvidaci') with no operating-bank branding; it does not represent the operating-period mark and was not used as the icon source.
